executive_summary: The project aims to modernize the existing codebase while preserving legacy functionalities and ensuring backward compatibility.

functional_requirements.title: Preserve Legacy Functionalities
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all existing functionalities are preserved in the modernized codebase.
acceptance_criteria: All legacy functions must produce identical outputs in the modernized system.
Legacy workflows must be fully operational without changes.
User interfaces must retain their current behavior and appearance.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Modern Error Handling
functional_requirements.description: Introduce structured error handling mechanisms in the modernized codebase.
acceptance_criteria: All errors must be logged with sufficient detail for debugging.
The system must handle exceptions gracefully without crashing.
Error messages must be user-friendly and actionable.

functional_requirements.title: Enhance Observability
functional_requirements.description: Integrate observability tools to monitor system performance and health.
acceptance_criteria: System metrics must be collected and visualized in real-time.
Alerts must be generated for critical performance issues.
Logs must be centralized for easy access and analysis.

functional_requirements.title: Maintain Backward Compatibility
functional_requirements.description: Ensure the modernized codebase remains compatible with existing interfaces and integrations.
acceptance_criteria: All existing APIs must function without modification.
Data formats must remain consistent with legacy systems.
Integration points must be tested to ensure seamless operation.

functional_requirements.title: Optimize Performance
functional_requirements.description: Improve the performance of the modernized codebase compared to the legacy system.
acceptance_criteria: Response times must be reduced by at least 20%.
Resource utilization must be optimized for efficiency.
The system must handle peak loads without degradation.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Automated Testing
functional_requirements.description: Introduce automated testing frameworks to ensure code quality and reliability.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests must cover at least 80% of the codebase.
Integration tests must validate all critical workflows.
Regression tests must be automated and run on each build.

functional_requirements.title: Update Documentation
functional_requirements.description: Revise and update all technical documentation to reflect the modernized codebase.
acceptance_criteria: All code changes must be documented with rationale and impact.
User manuals must be updated to reflect new functionalities.
API documentation must be complete and accurate.

functional_requirements.title: Ensure Security Compliance
functional_requirements.description: Implement security measures to comply with relevant standards and regulations.
acceptance_criteria: All data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access controls must be enforced according to best practices.
Security audits must be conducted regularly to identify vulnerabilities.
